title: Everyday Phrases — Gardening
title_quote: Let's visit the garden center today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🌻 實用園藝必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Gardening
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用園藝情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從園藝中心選購種子花盆，到翻土播種、日照施肥除蟲、收穫堆肥與鄰居分享，全程常用英文一次學會。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 400 practical Gardening phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from picking seeds and pots at the garden center to digging, sowing, feeding, pest care, harvest and sharing with neighbors. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's visit the garden center today.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天去園藝中心逛逛吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! I want to plant something new.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! aɪ wɑnt tə plænt ˈsʌmθɪŋ nu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll need seeds, pots, and good soil.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil nid sidz, pɑts, ənd ɡʊd sɔɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我們需要種子、花盆和好土。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And don't forget your old gloves.
dialogue.zh: 還有，別忘了你那副舊手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My gloves have holes in both hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡlʌvz hæv hoʊlz ɪn boʊθ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 我的手套兩隻都破洞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time for a fresh pair, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the seed aisle. Take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ðə sid aɪəl. teɪk jɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 種子走道在這裡，慢慢挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, so many colors on these packets.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, soʊ ˈmɛni ˈkʌlərz ɑn ðiz ˈpækɪts./
dialogue.zh: 哇，這些包裝上好多顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like these tomato seeds?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡這包番茄種子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but which kind is easiest to grow?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt wɪʧ kaɪnd ɪz ˈiːziəst tə groʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cherry tomato is best for beginners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɛri təˈmeɪtoʊ ɪz bɛst fər bɪˈɡɪnərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take two packets of those.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's get some basil seeds too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basil smells wonderful next to tomatoes.
dialogue.zh: 羅勒種在番茄旁邊香氣超棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These sunflowers grow really tall.
dialogue.zh: 這些向日葵會長得好高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plant them behind the fence in spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænt ðɛm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə fɛns ɪn sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 春天把它們種在圍籬後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does 'after the frost' mean here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dʌz ˈæftər ðə frɔst min hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡寫的「霜期之後」是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait until nights stay warm outside.
dialogue.zh: 就是等到夜裡變暖了再種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we sow these now or later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi soʊ ðiz naʊ ɔr ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在播還是晚一點再播？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nights are warm now. Let's sow!
dialogue.zh: 夜裡已經轉暖，我們就播種吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This packet says six seeds inside.
dialogue.zh: 這包裡面只有六顆種子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only six? I hoped for more.
dialogue.zh: 只有六顆？我還以為會多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pumpkin seeds are bigger and cheaper.
dialogue.zh: 南瓜種子比較大，也比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But one plant feeds our whole street.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt wʌn plænt fidz ˈaʊər hoʊl strit./
dialogue.zh: 但一棵就夠整條街的人吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these marigolds for the flower bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz ˈmærɪɡoʊldz fər ðə ˈflaʊər bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 這些萬壽菊是種在花圃裡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, their orange color keeps bugs away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛr ˈɔrɪndʒ ˈkʌlər kiːps bʌɡz əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，橘色的花能趕走蟲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flowers can help the vegetable garden?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Bees love them too.
dialogue.zh: 當然！蜜蜂也很喜歡它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, where are the planting supplies?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，種植用品放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just past the wheelbarrows, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæst ðə ˈwilˌbæroʊz, ɑn ðə lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep should a pot be for peppers?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ diːp ʃʊd ə pɑt bi fər ˈpɛpərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twelve inches is deep enough.
dialogue.zh: 大約十二英寸深就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do clay pots dry out faster?
dialogue.zh: 陶盆是不是乾得比較快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plastic ones hold water longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love these blue painted pots.
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡這些上藍漆的花盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'd look nice on the front porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðed lʊk naɪs ɑn ðə frʌnt pɔrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 擺在門廊上一定很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick one, but check the bottom first.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk wʌn, bʌt tʃɛk ðə ˈbɑtəm fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point! This one has no hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt! ðɪs wʌn hæz noʊ hoʊl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every pot needs holes for drainage.
dialogue.zh: 每個花盆都要有排水孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Else the roots will just rot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's grab a bag of potting soil.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡræb ə bæɡ ɑv ˈpɑtɪŋ sɔɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one or the small one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn ɔr ðə smɔl wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pots can one bag fill?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni pɑts kæn wʌn bæɡ fɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 一大袋土能裝滿幾個花盆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fills about three medium pots.
dialogue.zh: 裝滿三個中號花盆剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This mix holds water and air well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs mɪks hoʊldz ˈwɔtər ənd ɛr wɛl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for starting seeds indoors.
dialogue.zh: 拿來在室內育苗正合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never use garden soil in pots.
dialogue.zh: 花盆裡千萬別直接裝院裡的土。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not? What's bad about it?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？那樣有什麼不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It turns hard inside a container.
dialogue.zh: 裝進容器後它會結得很硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know. Thanks for the tip!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ. θæŋks fər ðə tɪp!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a trowel for small holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ˈtraʊəl fər smɔl hoʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 挖小洞需要一把園土鏟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The short one fits my hand best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɔrt wʌn fɪts maɪ hænd bɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These pruning shears feel light and sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈpruːnɪŋ ʃɪrz fil laɪt ənd ʃɑrp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test them before you buy anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new hose can wait until next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu hoʊz kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl nɛkst wiːk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed. We have one at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a watering can?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the kind with a gentle spout.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə kaɪnd wɪð ə ˈdʒɛntəl spaʊt./
dialogue.zh: 要，買壺嘴出水柔和的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These foam pads save your knees.
dialogue.zh: 這種泡綿墊能保護膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine are worn thin already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at these cute plant stakes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shapes of birds, moons, and suns.
dialogue.zh: 有小鳥、月亮和太陽造型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those labels or just decorations?
dialogue.zh: 那些是標籤還是裝飾品？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both! You can write names on them.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ! ju kæn raɪt neɪmz ɑn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 兩用！可以在上面寫名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seeds need water, warmth, and patience.
dialogue.zh: 種子需要水分、溫度和耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And maybe a little music.
dialogue.zh: 說不定還需要一點音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does music really help plants grow?
dialogue.zh: 音樂真的能幫植物長得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I play jazz, and they love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pleɪ dʒæz, ənd ðeɪ lʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我常放爵士樂，它們很買單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fertilizer is by the checkout.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the slow-release kind for pots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə sloʊ rɪˈlis kaɪnd fər pɑts./
dialogue.zh: 拿盆栽用的緩釋型那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is organic better for vegetables?
dialogue.zh: 用有機肥料對蔬菜比較好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many gardeners think so, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 很多種菜的人都堅定這麼想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the brown stuff in that bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑts ðə braʊn stʌf ɪn ðæt bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 那袋棕色的東西是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Compost. It makes soil really rich.
dialogue.zh: 堆肥，能讓土變得很肥沃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a wheelbarrow today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this shopping cart is enough.
dialogue.zh: 不用，這台購物車就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday mornings get busy here fast.
dialogue.zh: 這裡週六上午很快就擠滿人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why we came at nine.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們九點就趕來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the seed sale sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðə sid seɪl saɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 你看到種子特價的海報了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy three packets, get one free!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a great deal on marigolds.
dialogue.zh: 萬壽菊這個價錢真划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's add more flowers to the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts æd mɔr ˈflaʊərz tə ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 購物清單上多加幾種花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we forget the tomato cages?
dialogue.zh: 我們忘了番茄籠架了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, we need three of those.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, wi nid θri ʌv ðoz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Metal cages last for many years.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic ones break after one season.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those apple trees outside are flowering.
dialogue.zh: 外面那些蘋果樹都開花了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spring really is the gardening season.
dialogue.zh: 春天果然是園藝的季節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with card here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cash works too, of course.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that's everything on our list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, almost. I grabbed a succulent.
dialogue.zh: 差不多啦，我又順手拿了一株多肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A succulent? For the kitchen window?
dialogue.zh: 多肉植物？放廚房窗台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs almost no care at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt niːdz ˈɔlˌmoʊst noʊ kɛr æt ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You take the soil, I'll hold pots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju teɪk ðə sɔɪl, aɪl hoʊld pɑts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, that bag feels heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the notice on the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðə ˈnoʊtɪs ɑn ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你有看到門上的通知嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free plant swaps every first Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 每月第一個週六免費交換植株。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have to come back next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv tə kʌm bæk nɛkst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們一定要再來一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But today we go plant our seeds!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt təˈdeɪ wi ɡoʊ plænt ˈaʊər sidz!/
dialogue.zh: 但今天先回家種我們的種子！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's our sunny spot by the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ˈaʊər ˈsʌni spɑt baɪ ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我們向陽的角落就在牆邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Nothing blocks the sun here.
dialogue.zh: 很好，這裡沒有東西擋陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, we clear away all the old weeds.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, wi klɪr əˈweɪ ɔl ðə oʊld widz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll pull them out by their roots.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊl ðɛm aʊt baɪ ðɛr ruts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't drop the ones with seeds.
dialogue.zh: 結了籽的那幾株別亂抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll toss them in the trash bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɔs ðɛm ɪn ðə træʃ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我直接把它們丟進垃圾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rocks and sticks go in this bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɑks ənd stɪks ɡoʊ ɪn ðɪs ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 石頭和枯枝撿進桶子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This ground is pretty rocky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now loosen the soil with the fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈluːsən ðə sɔɪl wɪð ðə fɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 現在用叉子把土鬆一鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? Push and wiggle?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Go down about six inches.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My back already says hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the soil is dry and dusty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə sɔɪl ɪz draɪ ənd ˈdʌsti./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's water it before digging more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine by me. My arms need rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn baɪ mi. maɪ ɑrmz nid rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我沒意見，手臂需要休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hose is right over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spread the compost over the whole bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɛd ðə ˈkɑmpoʊst ˈoʊvər ðə hoʊl bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 把堆肥均勻撒滿整片花床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How thick should the layer be?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About one inch is plenty here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll work it in with the rake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɜrk ɪt ɪn wɪð ðə reɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我用耙子把它攪進土裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rakes are just for leveling here.
dialogue.zh: 耙子在這裡只用來弄平表面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your hands for the rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands? In the cold dirt?
dialogue.zh: 我的手？要插進冷泥巴裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real gardeners love dirty hands.
dialogue.zh: 真正的園藝人都愛髒手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you've convinced me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, it feels like fresh bread.
dialogue.zh: 你摸，土像新鮮麵包一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice and soft, full of air.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to mark our rows with sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm tə mɑrk ˈaʊər roʊz wɪð stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 該用樹枝把一行行標出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the tall plants sit in front?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə tɔl plænts sɪt ɪn frʌnt?/
dialogue.zh: 高的植物要種在前面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, put them in the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That way sun reaches every leaf.
dialogue.zh: 這樣陽光才照得到每片葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. The tomatoes take the back row.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt. ðə təˈmeɪtoʊz teɪk ðə bæk roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，那番茄種最後一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sow the seed row a finger deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə sid roʊ ə ˈfɪŋɡər dip./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A finger? Not with a ruler?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your finger knows better than a ruler.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈfɪŋɡər noʊz ˈbɛtər ðæn ə ˈrulər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always say that about gardening.
dialogue.zh: 一談到種花你就有一套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make a shallow line, drop seeds in.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ə ˈʃæloʊ laɪn, drɑp sidz ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 劃一道淺溝，把種子撒進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One seed every two inches?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, then cover them lightly with soil.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛn ˈkʌvər ðɛm ˈlaɪtli wɪð sɔɪl./
dialogue.zh: 對，然後輕輕蓋上一層土。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like tucking them into bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now press the ground nice and flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ prɛs ðə ɡraʊnd naɪs ənd flæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With my hands or my feet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feet work fine, but be gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, the tiniest footsteps ever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water the new rows with a fine spray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ðə nu roʊz wɪð ə faɪn spreɪ./
dialogue.zh: 用細水花澆剛播好的溝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The watering can is perfect for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtərɪŋ kæn ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ðɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't wash the seeds out!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, I moved one already.
dialogue.zh: 來不及了，已經有一顆被水沖歪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push it back and bury it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. It should be okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark this row with a label now.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrk ðɪs roʊ wɪð ə ˈleɪbəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 快用標籤把這一排做上記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row one says cherry tomato.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Label every row now, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, later they all look alike.
dialogue.zh: 也是，到時候幼苗全都長得一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seedlings arrived from the store!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little trays with the greens?
dialogue.zh: 是那盤綠油油的小苗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, lettuce and basil starts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look strong and healthy.
dialogue.zh: 它們看起來又壯又健康。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll transplant them this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 今天下午就把它們移栽下地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we water the trays first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, an hour before moving them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll dig the holes meanwhile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Space the lettuce a foot apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whole foot? They're so small.
dialogue.zh: 整整一英尺？它們還這麼小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They grow bigger than you think.
dialogue.zh: 它們會長得比你想的更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll measure with my feet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loosen the roots before planting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How hard should I squeeze?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gentle! The roots break easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oops, this one dropped some soil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's normal, keep going.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in its new hole now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plant it at the same depth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right where it sat in the tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wɛr ɪt sæt ɪn ðə treɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 就是它在盤裡坐的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly there, then firm the soil.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There. Like a firm handshake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water every transplant right away.
dialogue.zh: 每棵移栽的都馬上澆水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow drink at the base?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, right at the base.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look happy already.
dialogue.zh: 它們看起來已經很開心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beans will climb our new pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə binz wɪl klaɪm ˈaʊər nu poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 豆角會沿著新杆往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sow the seeds beside it.
dialogue.zh: 我把種子種在杆子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seeds per hole should do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sidz pɜr hoʊl ʃʊd du ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 每個坑放兩顆種子就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! I hope the birds agree.
dialogue.zh: 種好了！希望小鳥別有意見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cover the row with some netting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To keep the birds away?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the neighbor's cat, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves digging in fresh soil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The radish rows need some thinning.
dialogue.zh: 蘿蔔那排種太密，該疏苗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snip them out, don't pull.
dialogue.zh: 把它們剪掉就好，彆硬拔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Radishes love cool corners.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the hot spot's already taken.
dialogue.zh: 正好，曬的地方已經種滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you think, are we done?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du ju θɪŋk, ɑr wi dʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing. A bird bath!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not another statue in the yard.
dialogue.zh: 院子裡可不要再擺雕像了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a statue, a water bowl.
dialogue.zh: 不是雕像，是一個水盆啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our little garden rows look neat.
dialogue.zh: 我們的小菜園一行行真整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we wait and hope.
dialogue.zh: 接下來就等待和期盼吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll check for sprouts every morning.
dialogue.zh: 我每天早上都來看發芽沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your coffee out here.
dialogue.zh: 那把你的咖啡也端過來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is morning sun enough for herbs?
dialogue.zh: 香草只照到早晨的陽光夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Herbs love morning sun best.
dialogue.zh: 香草最喜歡早晨的陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the tomato leaves are curling.
dialogue.zh: 噢，番茄的葉子都捲起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was there too much sun yesterday?
dialogue.zh: 昨天是不是曬得太多了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or maybe not enough water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's soak them deep tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們把水澆透一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water the soil, never the leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not the leaves? They're dirty.
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不能澆葉？它們好髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet leaves get sick easily.
dialogue.zh: 葉子濕濕的很容易生病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Water at the base.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning is the best time to water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz ðə bɛst taɪm tə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 早上是最適合澆水的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before the sun gets strong?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Evening works too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But slugs love a wet night.
dialogue.zh: 但蛞蝓最愛濕潤的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the basil is flowering already.
dialogue.zh: 哇，羅勒竟然已經開花了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we pinch the flowers off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, or the leaves turn bitter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll pinch a few today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This month the beds need plant food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs mʌnθ ðə bɛdz nid plænt fud./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Liquid fertilizer or the granules?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Granules last longer in beds.
dialogue.zh: 顆粒的在土裡效力更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How often should we feed them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once a month is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll mark it on my calendar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sprinkle it along the bed edges.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then water it in, right?
dialogue.zh: 然後澆水讓它滲下去，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are these leaves so sticky?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some bug has been snacking here.
dialogue.zh: 肯定有蟲子在這裡偷吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check under the leaves for bugs.
dialogue.zh: 檢查葉子背面有沒有蟲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Tiny green ones everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 真的有！四處都是綠色小蟲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those are aphids. Don't panic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I just squash them?
dialogue.zh: 我直接把牠們捏死行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spray them off with the hose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will that really work?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus soapy water helps.
dialogue.zh: 有用，再加點肥皂水更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one drop of soap, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A few drops in a full sprayer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju drɑps ɪn ə fʊl ˈspreɪər./
dialogue.zh: 一整噴壺水加幾滴就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll mix it this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some yellow leaves are normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many before I worry?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trim them off with clean shears.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I disinfect them first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the blades with alcohol.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, they're sparkly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that tomato plant fell again.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ðæt təˈmeɪtoʊ plænt fɛl əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那株番茄又倒下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's tie it to a stake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tie it loosely, not tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a soft figure eight?
dialogue.zh: 像鬆鬆的八字結那樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a trick from my video.
dialogue.zh: 那是我影片裡教的一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, you make garden videos?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every week, little updates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll subscribe, my little gardener.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the beans need the tall pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ðə binz nid ðə tɔl poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 說起來，豆角還缺那根長杆呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks sturdy already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cucumbers climb too, see their tendrils?
dialogue.zh: 黃瓜也爬藤，看到捲鬚了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're grabbing the strings already!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weeds stole water from the flowers.
dialogue.zh: 雜草把花的水都搶走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll pull them before noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the young weeds after rain.
dialogue.zh: 下過雨後拔小草最容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come up so easily then.
dialogue.zh: 那時候拔起來最省力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never let weeds go to seed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, that one has flowers.
dialogue.zh: 來不及了，那株都開花了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag it. Don't put it in compost.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ ɪt. doʊnt pʊt ɪt ɪn ˈkɑmpoʊst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why? Isn't compost good?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weed seeds survive the pile.
dialogue.zh: 雜草籽在堆肥裡死不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, straight to the trash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A heat wave is coming this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hit weɪv ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ðɪs wiːk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine days above ninety?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pots will dry out fast.
dialogue.zh: 我們的花盆一下子就乾透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's group them together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They share humidity that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll shade the tomatoes too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we shade the peppers today?
dialogue.zh: 今天要不要幫甜椒遮陽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cover them at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the roses have black spots.
dialogue.zh: 你看，玫瑰葉上長了黑點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that some kind of disease?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, clean up the fallen leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Burn them or trash them?
dialogue.zh: 是燒掉還是丟進垃圾桶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the bin is safer here.
dialogue.zh: 呃，病葉丟進垃圾桶比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll cut the worst branches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut above an outward bud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which way is outward?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away from the center of the plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ frəm ðə ˈsɛntər ʌv ðə plænt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open to the sun and breeze.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Air keeps plants healthy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Look how open it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain all week. Stop watering.
dialogue.zh: 要下整週的雨，暫停澆水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, a gift from the sky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the pots under the eaves, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə pɑts ˈʌndər ðə ivz, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過屋簷下的花盆要留意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the roof blocks all that rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə ruf blɑks ɔl ðæt reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對呀，屋頂把那個角落的雨都擋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday's wind broke the lavender stem.
dialogue.zh: 昨天的強風把薰衣草的莖吹折了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we still save it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut it short and root it in water.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ɪt ʃɔrt ənd ruːt ɪt ɪn ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 剪短插進水裡就能生根。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free new plants again.
dialogue.zh: 我們又有免費新植株了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look how huge the squash leaves got!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk haʊ hjuːdʒ ðə skwɑʃ livz ɡɑt!/
dialogue.zh: 看那南瓜葉，長得多麼大！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They shade the whole ground.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice job keeping everything alive.
dialogue.zh: 你把每樣植物都照顧得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garden keeps me alive.
dialogue.zh: 是花園讓我精神飽滿呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week the flowers should bloom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring the camera then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look! The first tomato turned red.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick it and taste it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ɪt ənd teɪst ɪt raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm from the sun, so sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than any store tomato.
dialogue.zh: 比店裡賣的番茄好吃太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm saving seeds from this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry them on paper first.
dialogue.zh: 先把種子攤在紙上晾乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lettuce is ready to cut.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The outer leaves or the head?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut outer leaves, keep it growing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it gives us more salad.
dialogue.zh: 這樣就有吃不完的沙拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These beans are thick on the vine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz binz ɑr θɪk ɑn ðə vaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這些豆角結滿了一整架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should pick them today.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天就要把它採完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick the young, tender pods.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the fat ones for seeds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The basil grew huge again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut some for the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snip flowers for the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marigolds last for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut them early in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flowers hold more water then.
dialogue.zh: 那個時候花吸的水最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at this giant pumpkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From that one cheap seed?
dialogue.zh: 就是那顆便宜種子長的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It grew bigger than my helmet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can't get that inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Load it on the old wagon.
dialogue.zh: 把它放到那輛舊推車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our whole garden looks so full.
dialogue.zh: 我們整個花園一派豐收景象。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much zucchini again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same problem as last year.
dialogue.zh: 跟去年的煩惱一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grate it into bread.
dialogue.zh: 磨碎了烤成麵包來吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or share it with the neighbors.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pick a basket for Ms. Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll love these fresh veggies!
dialogue.zh: 她一定很愛這些新鮮蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ripe peppers for her porch.
dialogue.zh: 挑幾根漂亮的熟椒掛上她門廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll be so happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mr. Kim grows prize tomatoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him for his advice.
dialogue.zh: 去跟他請教一下祕訣吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our tomatoes look amazing this year.
dialogue.zh: 咱們今年的番茄長得真棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll love that compliment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't dump scraps on the ground.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the compost they go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee grounds help worms work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are those worms in the pile?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Millions of them, busy workers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I used to hate worms.
dialogue.zh: 我其實以前很討厭蚯蚓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the pile once a week.
dialogue.zh: 每週要把堆肥翻動一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It heats up from inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means it's working well.
dialogue.zh: 那表示分解進行得很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a small volcano.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finished compost smells like a forest.
dialogue.zh: 完成的堆肥聞起來像森林。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark, rich, and soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next spring it feeds the beds.
dialogue.zh: 明年春天就輪到它養花床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From scraps back to soil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake the dirt off your tools.
dialogue.zh: 先把工具上的泥巴拍乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wipe the metal blades.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil keeps them from rusting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick rub with an oily rag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪk rʌb wɪð ən ˈɔɪli ræɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the empty watering cans.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So nothing sits inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing water breeds mosquitoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tip them out now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drain the hose before frost.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It split last winter.
dialogue.zh: 它去年冬天就凍裂過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coil it loosely on the hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too tight, got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we store the pots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the porch bench.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack small pots inside big ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whole pot family.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seeds go in jars, keep them dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /sidz ɡoʊ ɪn dʒɑrz, kip ðɛm draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 種子裝進罐子保持乾燥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll date every single jar.
dialogue.zh: 我要在每一罐標上日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cool shelf, not the garage.
dialogue.zh: 放涼爽的架子，別放車庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mice found my beans once.
dialogue.zh: 車庫那裡的老鼠之前就翻到過我的豆子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they eat all of them?
dialogue.zh: 牠們把豆子全都吃光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the biggest ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean your boots before storage.
dialogue.zh: 收起來之前先把雨靴清乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mud's like cement now.
dialogue.zh: 上面的泥巴硬得像水泥了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrape it with an old spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, spoons are the best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gloves need a wash.
dialogue.zh: 手套也該好好洗一洗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By hand, or they shrink in the wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ hænd, ɔr ðeɪ ʃrɪŋk ɪn ðə wɑʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quiet garden all winter.
dialogue.zh: 整個冬天花園都會很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The beds will rest, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cover the soil with fallen leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winter blankets for the worms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the jars of saved seeds.
dialogue.zh: 數數看留種的罐有幾個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough to fill half the yard.
dialogue.zh: 足夠把半個院子種滿滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plan next year's garden tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚就來規畫明年的花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More squash and fewer weeds?
dialogue.zh: 多種南瓜、少點雜草怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weeds always come uninvited.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! That's so true.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The neighbors want a garden tour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning at ten?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring them by the tomato rows.
dialogue.zh: 帶他們去看看番茄那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll ask for seeds again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the best part of gardening.
dialogue.zh: 這就是園藝最美好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharing the harvest with friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From one packet to a full table.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm wʌn ˈpækɪt tə ə fʊl ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 從一包種子到滿桌蔬果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From soil to supper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And next spring, we start again.
dialogue.zh: 明年春天，我們再來一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll have my gloves ready.
